sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY • Data Analyst experienced in collecting, storing, retrieving, and
analyzing business-related data to support strategic decision-making.
Proficient in Excel, including Charts, PivotTables, Slicers, Index Match, VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, nested formulas, named ranges, and dashboard creation.
Skilled in data modeling, transformation, and visualization using PowerPivot, Power Query, and Power BI.
Strong expertise in SQL: writing advanced queries, joins, views, and working with DDL, DML, DQL, DCL, and TCL commands.
Experienced in designing and developing interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI, including DAX functions, Query Editor, and data modeling.
Knowledgeable in connecting to multiple data sources, transforming raw data into actionable insights, and enabling data-driven decision-making.
Expertise in implementing security measures like Row-Level Security (RLS) and managing user permissions in Power BI Service.
Skilled in publishing, sharing, and scheduling automated report refreshes in Power BI Service.
Experienced in designing robust Excel applications with VBA programming and object-oriented approaches.
Exposure to relational databases and database concepts, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Adept at gathering business requirements, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering solutions with minimal supervision.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate technical information effectively to clients and stakeholders.

EXPERIENCE HISTORY
ASSOCIATE DATA ANALYST ATYATI TECHNOLOGIES PVT.LTD / 06/2018 - 08/2021
Performed periodic data gathering, analysis, and reporting to support business decision-making.
Designed and developed interactive dashboards using Advanced Excel and Power BI.
Imported and transformed data from various sources (databases, Excel, CSV files) intoPower BI for analysis.
Designed and implemented data models in Power BI, establishing relationships, calculated columns, and measures.
• Optimized Power BI reports and dashboards to reduce data refresh
times and improve report load performance.
• Integrated Python, SQL, and Power BI to automate data refreshes,
report generation, and distribution processes.
Manipulated, cleansed, and processed data using Advanced Excel and Advanced SQL.
Developed complex SQL queries, including joins, subqueries, and data modification commands.
Used Python (Pandas, NumPy) for data cleaning, preprocessing, and transformation, handling missing values, duplicates, and data type conversions.
Automated ETL processes using Python for scheduled data extraction, transformation, and loading.
Performed data validation, loading, and extraction for client data.
Analyzed raw data, derived insights, and developed actionable recommendations.
Conducted data auditing to ensure accuracy, completeness, and reliability of reports.
Supplied qualitative and quantitative data to internal teams and clients.
Delivered client demos in the DSB project.
Collected, analyzed, evaluated, and reported data to increase operational productivity.
Prepared customized reports to support ongoing business decisions.
Validated device and geo creation requests as part of operational processes.
Measured order quality by segment, product group, and sector.
DATA ANALYST GENPACT INDIA PVT.LTD / 09/2021 - 08/2024
Developed interactive dashboards using Advanced Excel, Power BI, and Oracle, providing end-to-end visibility of supply chain processes.
Built relationships between multiple data tables, defined calculated columns, measures, and hierarchies to structure and organize data in Power BI and Excel.
Designed visually appealing dashboards with tables, charts, and maps to present actionable insights.
Created custom calculations and measures using DAX formulas to perform advanced analytics in Power BI.
Transformed and cleaned data using Power Query Editor, including merging, splitting, and unpivoting data.
Published reports to Power BI Service, managing permissions, data refresh schedules, and collaboration with stakeholders.
Implemented role-based security in Power BI to restrict access and ensure data confidentiality.
Wrote advanced SQL queries to retrieve, filter, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Performed JOIN operations to integrate data from multiple tables for comprehensive analysis.
Applied aggregate functions (SUM, AVG, COUNT, MAX, MIN) to calculate metrics like total sales, average order value, and inventory levels.
Executed INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE statements for database management and maintained data integrity.
Utilized WHERE clauses and ORDER BY to filter and organize query results for reporting purposes.
Integrated data from ERP systems, databases, APIs, and external files using Python.
• Automated ETL processes, data cleaning, transformation, and report
generation using Python scripts.
• Applied Python for data security, encryption, authentication, and
compliance with GDPR/HIPAA standards.
• Processed large volumes of supply chain data using Python libraries for
filtering, aggregation, normalization, and sorting.
Forecasted demand, managed inventory, and planned replenishment cycles to prevent stockouts or overstock situations.
Served as a liaison between Supply Chain, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and IT, providing analytical insights to stakeholders.
Reported KPIs to account managers, directors, and senior management on a weekly and monthly basis.
Conducted quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify trends and operational inefficiencies.
Managed vendor and customer relationships to ensure smooth supply chain operations.
Hands-on experience in Purchase Order creation, release, scheduling agreements, goods issue, and goods receipt.
Participated in weekly client calls to discuss forecasting, inventory issues, and process improvement initiatives.
Assisted in developing, writing, and approving SOPs to enhance business processes.
Built and maintained effective relationships with key stakeholders and team members.
Demonstrated strong interpersonal and communication skills- , supporting cross-functional collaboration.
Developed acumen in defining KPIs and identifying operational trends to improve supply chain efficiency.
SENIOR ANALYST ACCENTURE SOLUTIONS PVT.LTD / 08/2024 - PRESENT
Designed and delivered People analytics and business intelligence solutions using SQL, Power BI, Python, and Advanced Excel to support workforce and organizational decision-making.
Built and maintained interactive Power BI dashboards to analyze employee compensation, equity, and workforce metrics across multiple geographies including US, Canada, and Puerto Rico.
Using Power Query Editor to transform and clean data before loading it into Power BI. This includes tasks such as data cleansing, merging, splitting, and unpivoting.
Published and shared reports and dashboards to the Power BI Service, setting up data refresh schedules, managing permissions, and collaborating with team members.
Developed and optimized complex SQL queries (joins, CTEs, aggregations) to extract, transform, and validate large-scale HR datasets from multiple source systems.
Created efficient Power BI data models and implemented DAX calculations to enable trend analysis, regional comparisons, and leadership reporting.
Automated end-to-end data extraction and reporting workflows using Python, improving data refresh reliability and reducing manual effort.
Implemented Python scripts to fetch source data from source systems and load it into downstream reporting and promotion tools.
Performed data quality checks, reconciliation, and validation using SQL and Excel to ensure accuracy of sensitive compensation and equity data.
Utilized Advanced Excel (Power Query, Pivot Tables, lookup functions, macros) for ad-hoc analysis, data cleansing, and stakeholder reporting.
Collaborated with HR, Compensation, and Business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable analytical solutions. • Ensured adherence to data governance, compliance, and security
standards while handling confidential employee information.
• Improved dashboard performance and data refresh times through SQL
optimization and efficient BI design.
Used Python Pandas and NumPy to clean and preprocess raw data obtained from various sources such as databases, CSV files, or APIs and this involves tasks such as handling missing values, removing duplicates, and converting data types.
Leveraged Excel to validate data, perform reconciliations, and generate summary reports for management and cross-functional teams.
